messages:
Maya: Heads-up — prepping airgap installer shim batch for VPC customers in eu-central. Need a QA handshake + transport window for cosign/KMS key rotation. ETA bundle creation: 2025-09-22 02:00 UTC. Any objections to pinning installer v1.9.3-shim?
Jordan: No objections, but we need to ensure the packager computes and embeds the manifest envelope (signer_ts + kms_key_id). If envelope missing we abort. @QA-Bot can you confirm the validation run tomorrow morning?
QA-Bot: Auto-check scheduled: job=qa-validation/installer-envelope; run_at=2025-09-22T01:20:00Z. Will post results.
DeployBot: transport-job created id=tr-45721; priority=high; window=2025-09-22T02:00:00Z..2025-09-22T06:00:00Z. Canary set=5% of customers tagged 'vpc-onprem-canary'.
Sam: Quick note on release notes: please include "installer shim: pinned v1.9.3-shim (airgap) — cosign signed, KMS key rotation applied, rollback policy v1.9.2 available". Also add a short ops play for checksum mismatch.
Kevin: Ops capacity check — allocating 2 escorts (Alice + Tom) for the 4-hour window and on-call pagers set. If any transport job reports "manifest-mismatch" escalate to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Rollback criteria proposal: if >1% of canary hosts report checksum mismatch OR cosign verify fails against kms:trigger-key, then halt remaining transport, unpin installer in staging, and republish v1.9.2 with emergency flag.
Maya: Agreed. Also add a soft-fail fallback route: if cosign verification fails but checksum passes, allow pause + manual signer rotation instead of immediate rollback.
DeployBot: Note: automated post-check commands that will run on canaries:
```
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/kms-rot-02 bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
deployctl transport status tr-45721 --canary
```
DeployBot: I will post a summary once post-checks finish. tagging @Sam @Jordan
Sam: FYI — update to docs: docs/releases/private-airgap.md needs a short section "shim metadata envelope" with the exact JSON fields expected by QA.
Maya: I'll add the docs PR after QA green. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
